name: Mohammad Miri
summary: Energy systems engineer, modeller, and technical product lead with 10+ years spanning distribution grid modernization, national bulk-power optimization, and building thermal engineering. Currently leads product methodology and cross-functional delivery for the Non-Wires and Grid Solution Evaluation capability within Deloitte's ElectrifiedGrid platform, helping utilities and policymakers evaluate distributed energy resources (DERs), non-wires alternatives, and traditional wires investments. Background combines national regulatory modelling (ECCC), Ph.D. research on bulk power systems studying flexibility requirements to enable higher renewable penetration and machine-learning surrogates, and hands-on HVAC and building energy design across 20+ developments.

experience.title: Senior Specialist (Product & Modelling Lead, Grid Solution Evaluation)
bullets: Serve as Product and Modelling Lead for the platform's Non-Wires and Grid Solution Evaluation Module, directing a cross-functional team across backend, frontend, UI/UX, and quantitative modelling from early concept through MVP release, client UAT, and executive and partner demonstrations.

Own the module's functional architecture, data model, and product roadmap, leading the integration design that connects upstream demand forecasting and probabilistic grid-impact simulations with downstream solution evaluation and investment planning.

Led rapid end-to-end prototyping and delivery of a combined NWA and traditional wires screening and viability tool for a major U.S. electric utility, and drove the resulting feature expansions (multi-tier wires upgrades, lead-time bridging logic, and utility-scale battery storage) into the core product roadmap.

Navigated client requirements for a major Ontario distribution utility from discovery through functional design, development, and delivery of an in-product flexibility-market capacity contract evaluator, grounded in international DSO market structures.

Led end-to-end methodology design, prototyping, and delivery for behind-the-meter battery energy storage (BESS) modelling across residential and commercial sectors, applying state-of-the-art dispatch simulation, techno-economic payback, and Bass diffusion adoption methods.

Developed industrial electrification load-profile simulators for electric boilers and process heat pumps (COP modelled as a function of temperature lift), delivering standardized hourly thermal-demand profiles to the platform's core modelling toolset.

experience.title: Project Engineer
experience.org: Environment and Climate Change Canada, Vancouver, BC
bullets: Enhanced the optimization modelling framework for economic and energy assessment of the Clean Electricity Regulations, including hydro development decisions, load decomposition, alternative fuel coverage, and improved spatial representation of variable renewable capacities.

Assessed policy and market scenarios on the Canadian power system, with attention to demand-side and cross-sectoral resources (electrification of heating, EV load, DSM) and integration of non-traditional resources.
Built a clustering pipeline (Pandas, scikit-learn) for VRE site selection, improving time-series representation of profiles by ~10× and cutting model runtime by ~20%.
Coordinated with 15+ provincial governments and system operators; supported stakeholder sessions with analytics and visualizations for regulatory feedback and multi-model review.
Maintained Python tooling for data analysis and automation, including documentation, testing, CI/CD integration, and version control (Azure DevOps, Git).

experience.title: Researcher
experience.org: Sustainable Energy Systems Integration Team (SESIT), University of Victoria, Victoria, BC
bullets: Built a residential building archetype framework from Alberta census data (five archetypes: heat pumps vs. gas furnaces with electric water heating), parameterized for thermal performance and HVAC end-use shares.
Developed EnergyPlus models per archetype for hourly space-heating and water-heating behaviour under baseline and demand-response scenarios, feeding system-level studies.
Designed a data-linked optimization and simulation framework for price-signal vs. direct-load-control DR, demonstrating ~8% VRE curtailment reduction and ~1.5% operational cost improvement (Energy).
Introduced model constraints for cascading storage hydro in optimal dispatch and long-term planning (Renewable & Sustainable Energy Transition).
Built a neural-network surrogate for expensive simulation runs, reducing evaluation time from 8+ hours to ~30 seconds (~96×) at preserved accuracy (Energy Reports).

experience.title: Research Analyst
experience.org: Sharif Energy Research Institute (SERI), Tehran, Iran
bullets: Introduced and calibrated a workforce production function within a computable general equilibrium (CGE) optimization model to include emissions health impacts and a carbon-tax commodity, characterizing an economy-wide rebound effect (~18%).

experience.title: Lead Energy Engineer
bullets: Led energy and HVAC design on 20+ commercial and residential developments (~1,500 m² to ~50,000 m²), from concept through construction support and commissioning.
Performed heating, cooling, and ventilation load calculations and system sizing per ASHRAE standards and local codes; coordinated multi-disciplinary teams of 3-5 engineers.

Developed whole-building energy models (EnergyPlus, DesignBuilder) for envelope, HVAC, and control alternatives, code compliance, and lifecycle cost analysis; conducted industrial energy audits and CHP retrofit studies.
